errors.text_span: Die Balken für 2024 und 2025 sind schraffiert dargestellt
errors.evidence: The description states that the bars for 2024 and 2025 are hatched. However, only the purple bars (60 % des Medianlohns) are hatched for these years; the blue bars (Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn) are solid.

The description interprets the hatched pattern on the bars for 2024 and 2025 as indicating 'prognostizierte Werte' (forecasted values). This meaning is not provided anywhere in the chart itself (title, axes, legend).
